title: zazzle-lang deployment diagram
description: Each release builds one module per language (a universal .dylib on macOS, signed when signing is configured; a .so per Linux architecture), writes their SHA-256s into a manifest that zazzled embeds, and uploads them to icelander.net/downloads/zazzle/vX.Y.Z/languages/PLATFORM/. On a developer's machine zazzled downloads a module the first time a file needs it (JIT, on unless `zazzle languages jit off`) or on `zazzle languages fetch`, checks its hash, stores it in ~/.zazzle/v1/languages and loads it with dlopen.
